$comment: Generated by scripts/aifn-catalog.ts (make catalog) from the registries of aifn and aifn-applied; do not edit. Each entry is its registry info with Spaces inlined, addressed <module>/<key> within its kind.

agent.name: Random agent
agent.summary: Acts uniformly at random over a discrete action domain and learns nothing: the baseline every agent beats.

agent.name: Q-learning agent
agent.summary: ε-greedy Q-learning, one TD update per transition, on any environment with discrete observations and actions.

algorithm.name: Adaptive BDF
algorithm.summary: Variable-order (1–5), variable-step backward differentiation formulae (NDF) for stiff problems, as scipy BDF.

algorithm.name: Backward differentiation formula
algorithm.summary: The BDF methods of order 1 to 3 for stiff problems.

algorithm.name: Dormand–Prince
algorithm.summary: The adaptive 5(4) embedded Runge–Kutta pair with error-controlled step sizes.

algorithm.name: Explicit Runge–Kutta
algorithm.summary: A fixed-step explicit Runge–Kutta method from a Butcher tableau (Euler, Heun, midpoint, RK4).

algorithm.name: Symplectic integrator
algorithm.summary: Symplectic Euler, leapfrog and higher-order splittings for separable Hamiltonians.

algorithm.name: Edmonds–Karp
algorithm.summary: Maximum flow by shortest augmenting paths.

algorithm.name: Minimum-cost flow
algorithm.summary: Minimum-cost flow by successive shortest paths with potentials.

algorithm.name: Chain sum–product
algorithm.summary: Sum–product (or max–product) on a chain-shaped factor graph.

algorithm.name: Enumeration
algorithm.summary: Exact inference by enumerating every assignment.

algorithm.name: Expectation propagation over a linear-Gaussian model
Gibbs sampling on a factor graph
GAM by Adam
algorithm.summary: Adam on the penalised deviance per observation, full batch, with the gradient by autodiff.

algorithm.name: GAM by backfitting
algorithm.summary: Backfitting with local scoring: one sweep of penalised smoothers over the terms per step.

algorithm.name: GAM by gradient descent
algorithm.summary: Gradient descent on the penalised deviance per observation, with the gradient by autodiff.

algorithm.name: GAM by L-BFGS
algorithm.summary: L-BFGS with a strong Wolfe line search on the penalised deviance per observation, by autodiff.

algorithm.name: GAM by penalised IRLS
algorithm.summary: Penalised IRLS on a GAM problem: weighted ridge-type solves on the working response, with step halving.

algorithm.name: GAM by minibatch SGD
algorithm.summary: Stochastic gradient descent on minibatch estimates of the penalised deviance, by autodiff.

algorithm.name: Training loop
algorithm.summary: Minibatch training of a network: forward, loss, gradients and an optimiser update per step.

algorithm.name: Continuation
algorithm.summary: Natural-parameter continuation from an easy problem to the target, with a Newton corrector.

algorithm.name: Linear conjugate gradient
algorithm.summary: Conjugate gradient for Ax = b with A symmetric positive definite.

algorithm.name: EMD sifting
algorithm.summary: The sifting iterations that extract one intrinsic mode function.

algorithm.name: Variational mode decomposition
algorithm.summary: ADMM sweeps that fit K narrow-band modes and their centre frequencies together, in the Fourier domain.

algorithm.name: Least mean squares (LMS)
algorithm.summary: An adaptive FIR filter that takes one stochastic-gradient step on the squared error per sample.

algorithm.name: Normalised LMS
algorithm.summary: LMS with each step divided by the regressor's energy, so the step size does not depend on the input scale.

algorithm.name: Recursive least squares (RLS)
algorithm.summary: An adaptive FIR filter that keeps the exact exponentially weighted least-squares taps, updated per sample.

algorithm.name: LTI simulation
algorithm.summary: Steps a discrete LTI system x[k+1] = A x[k] + B u[k] through an input sequence.

bijector.name: chain
bijector.summary: The composition of bijectors, applied left to right.

bijector.name: ordered
bijector.summary: Maps ℝᴷ onto increasing vectors: the first entry, then positive gaps (ordinal thresholds).

dataset.name: Anscombe's quartet
dataset.summary: Four small datasets with the same summary statistics and different shapes.

dataset.name: Coal-mining disasters
dataset.summary: Yearly counts of British coal-mining disasters, 1851–1962.

dataset.name: Fonts
dataset.summary: Capital-letter outlines of 66 fonts in dense correspondence, one row per font.

dataset.name: Iris
dataset.summary: Fisher's iris measurements: 150 flowers, four features, three species.

dataset.name: Old Faithful
dataset.summary: Eruption durations and waiting times of the Old Faithful geyser.

dataset.name: Additive model data
dataset.summary: Draws from a GAM: a named shape per uniform feature, through a link, with a Gaussian, binomial, Poisson or gamma response.

dataset.name: Anisotropic blobs
dataset.summary: Gaussian blobs sheared by one linear map, so the clusters are elongated (the scikit-learn k-means example).

dataset.name: AR regimes
dataset.summary: A series that switches between autoregressive regimes at changepoints.

dataset.name: AR series
dataset.summary: An autoregressive series started near stationarity (coefficients default [0.8]).

dataset.name: Bars and stripes
dataset.summary: Every bars-and-stripes pattern on a square grid.

dataset.name: Gaussian blobs
dataset.summary: Isotropic Gaussian blobs around random or evenly spaced centres (scikit-learn make_blobs).

dataset.name: Occasionally dishonest casino
dataset.summary: Die rolls from a two-state hidden Markov model: a fair die and a loaded one.

dataset.name: Checkerboard
dataset.summary: Points on a board of alternating tiles, the class given by the tile colour.

dataset.name: Checkerboard image
dataset.summary: A greyscale checkerboard of square tiles.

dataset.name: Concentric circles
dataset.summary: A small circle inside a large one, with Gaussian noise (scikit-learn make_circles).

dataset.name: Click log
dataset.summary: Logged rankings and clicks under a position-bias or cascade click model.

dataset.name: One-dimensional smooth regression
dataset.summary: A smooth curve on [0, 1] with heteroscedastic normal or skewed noise, Poisson counts, Bernoulli outcomes or gamma responses; the truth knows the whole law, so the true expectile curves.

dataset.name: Digit glyphs
dataset.summary: The ten digits of a 5 × 7 pixel font.

dataset.name: Noisy digits
dataset.summary: Copies of the 5 × 7 digit glyphs with flipped pixels and Gaussian noise, labelled by digit.

dataset.name: Friedman #1
dataset.summary: Friedman's first benchmark: a nonlinear function of five uniform inputs plus uninformative ones.

dataset.name: Gaussian classes
dataset.summary: Gaussian classes with given means and covariances; separation sets d′, the Mahalanobis distance of the closest means.

dataset.name: Gradient image
dataset.summary: A linear ramp in a direction, or a radial one from the centre.

dataset.name: Linear regression data
dataset.summary: A linear model with Gaussian noise and AR(1)-correlated features.

dataset.name: Mean shifts
dataset.summary: A piecewise-constant mean in Gaussian noise, with changepoints drawn at a constant hazard.

dataset.name: Two moons
dataset.summary: Two interleaving half circles with Gaussian noise (scikit-learn make_moons).

dataset.name: Poisson rate shifts
dataset.summary: Counts whose Poisson rate changes between segments.

dataset.name: Random walk
dataset.summary: Cumulative Gaussian steps with an optional drift.

dataset.name: Low-rank ratings
dataset.summary: A partly observed user × item rating matrix from a low-rank taste model, rounded to a 1–5 scale.

dataset.name: One-dimensional regression
dataset.summary: y = f(x) + noise for a named function f of one input.

dataset.name: Rings
dataset.summary: Concentric rings of radii 1, 2 and 3 with radial noise.

dataset.name: S-curve
dataset.summary: An S-shaped surface in three dimensions; `t` is the position along the S.

dataset.name: Seasonal series
dataset.summary: Level, trend and harmonic seasonality plus white or AR(1) noise.

dataset.name: Shapes image
dataset.summary: A rectangle, a disk, a triangle and a checkerboard patch on a dark background.

dataset.name: Spirals
dataset.summary: Interleaved spiral arms, one class per arm.

dataset.name: Swiss roll
dataset.summary: A rolled-up rectangle in three dimensions; `t` is the position along the roll.

dataset.name: Variance shifts
dataset.summary: Gaussian noise whose standard deviation changes between segments.

dataset.name: XOR
dataset.summary: Opposite quadrants share a class: uniform on the square or Gaussian blobs at (±1, ±1).

dataset.name: Zipf catalogue
dataset.summary: Item popularity following a Zipf law, with interactions drawn from it.

distribution.name: Categorical
distribution.summary: One of K categories with probabilities p (a vector, or logits).

categories.label: K
categories.doc: number of categories (the length of p)

distribution.name: Gamma (scale)
distribution.summary: The gamma family parameterised by shape and scale θ = 1/β; its instances are named Gamma.

distribution.name: Independent
distribution.summary: Reinterprets batch axes of a distribution as event axes.

reinterpreted.doc: batch axes moved into the event

distribution.name: Mixture
distribution.summary: A finite mixture of univariate components with given weights.

distribution.name: Multivariate normal
distribution.summary: A normal distribution on ℝᵈ with mean vector μ and a covariance, precision or Cholesky factor.

distribution.name: Pushforward
distribution.summary: A univariate distribution pushed through a many-to-one map, summing over preimages.

distribution.name: Transformed
distribution.summary: A univariate distribution pushed through a monotone bijector, with the change-of-variables density.

environment.name: Bernoulli bandit
environment.summary: Arms paying 1 with their mean probability, else 0; the means are a required argument.

environment.name: Cliff walking
environment.summary: A start and a goal along the edge of a cliff that sends the agent back to the start at a large cost.

environment.name: FrozenLake
environment.summary: Gymnasium’s FrozenLake: cross the ice to the goal without falling through a hole, on slippery ice or not.

environment.name: Gaussian bandit
environment.summary: Arms paying Gaussian rewards around their means; the means are a required argument.

environment.name: Gridworld
environment.summary: A grid of cells with walls and terminal rewards, where moves slip sideways with probability `noise`.

environment.name: Linear bandit
environment.summary: Arms are feature vectors whose mean reward is linear in an unknown θ*; θ* is a required option.

environment.name: Maze
environment.summary: A maze drawn as rows of characters (start, goal, walls, traps), with optional slip; the rows are required.

environment.name: Maze environment
environment.summary: A maze on the environment protocol: cell-index observations, four moves, a tabular model and a grid render.

filter-design.name: Butterworth
filter-design.summary: A maximally flat passband; the edge is the −3 dB point.

cutoff.label: W_n
cutoff.doc: edge, as a fraction of the Nyquist frequency

filter-design.name: Chebyshev type I
filter-design.summary: An equiripple passband of a given ripple and a monotone stopband.

cutoff.label: W_n
cutoff.doc: edge, as a fraction of the Nyquist frequency

filter-design.name: Chebyshev type II
filter-design.summary: A monotone passband and an equiripple stopband a given attenuation down.

cutoff.label: W_n
cutoff.doc: edge, as a fraction of the Nyquist frequency

filter-design.name: FIR window method
filter-design.summary: A linear-phase FIR filter: the ideal impulse response truncated by a window.

numtaps.label: N
numtaps.doc: number of taps (odd for high-pass and band-stop)

cutoff.label: W_n
cutoff.doc: edge, as a fraction of the Nyquist frequency

kernel.name: Matérn
kernel.summary: The Matérn kernel with smoothness ν ∈ {1/2, 3/2, 5/2}, given as the first argument.

kernel.name: Polynomial
kernel.summary: The polynomial kernel (σ_b² + σ² xᵀx′)^d, with the degree d given as the first argument.

log-density.name: Banana
log-density.summary: A Gaussian bent into a crescent by a quadratic shift of one coordinate, with exact moments.

log-density.name: Neal's funnel
log-density.summary: A hierarchical funnel whose scale varies over orders of magnitude, hard for fixed-step samplers.

log-density.name: Gaussian mixture target
log-density.summary: An isotropic Gaussian mixture, a multimodal test for samplers; the means and sd are required arguments.

log-density.name: Gaussian target
log-density.summary: A multivariate Gaussian N(μ, Σ); the mean and covariance are required arguments.

log-density.name: Non-centred funnel
log-density.summary: The funnel in its non-centred parametrisation, an isotropic Gaussian, with the map back to the funnel.

loss.name: Gaussian negative log-likelihood
loss.target: the conditional mean and standard deviation

loss.name: Huber loss
loss.target: a location between the conditional mean and median

loss.name: Log-cosh loss
loss.target: a location between the conditional mean and median

loss.name: Softmax cross-entropy
loss.target: the class log-probabilities, up to a constant per example

loss.name: Sampled softmax
loss.target: the full softmax cross-entropy (with the logQ correction)

model.name: Gaussian process regression
model.summary: Exact GP regression with optional type-II maximum-likelihood hyperparameters; the kernel is a required argument.

model.name: Gaussian process classifier
model.summary: Binary GP classification by the Laplace approximation or EP; the kernel is a required argument.

model.name: Gaussian process ordinal regression
model.summary: A GP latent function with the cumulative probit likelihood, by the Laplace approximation; thresholds, noise and kernel fitted to the evidence. The kernel is a required argument.

model.name: Sparse Gaussian process regression
model.summary: Inducing-point GP regression (VFE, FITC or DTC); the kernel is a required argument.

model.name: Expectile GAM
model.summary: An additive model of the τ-expectile, fitted by iteratively reweighted least asymmetric squares.

model.name: Explainable boosting machine
model.summary: A GAM of binned shape functions learned by cyclic gradient boosting.

model.name: Generalised additive model
model.summary: A sum of penalised smooth terms with smoothing parameters chosen by REML or GCV; the terms are a required argument.

model.name: Generalised linear model
model.summary: An exponential-family response with a link, fitted by iteratively reweighted least squares; the family is a required argument.

model.name: Logistic regression
model.summary: Binary or softmax logistic regression fitted by Newton steps, with a Bernoulli or categorical predictive.

model.name: Multinomial logistic regression
model.summary: Softmax regression with a reference class and Wald standard errors.

model.name: Negative binomial regression
model.summary: A log-linear count model with an estimated overdispersion θ, alternating IRLS and a θ update.

model.name: Binary decomposition (Frank and Hall)
model.summary: K − 1 logistic classifiers of P(y > k), differenced into class probabilities.

model.name: Deep ordinal regression
model.summary: An MLP score with a CORAL or cumulative-link ordinal head, trained by Adam.

model.name: Ordinal regression
model.summary: Cumulative-link, continuation-ratio or adjacent-category model of ordered classes, fitted by L-BFGS.

model.name: Threshold ordinal regression
model.summary: A linear score and ordered thresholds fitted by the all-threshold or immediate-threshold loss.

model.name: Bernoulli naive Bayes
model.summary: Class-conditional independent binary features with additive smoothing.

model.name: Gaussian naive Bayes
model.summary: Class-conditional independent Gaussians per feature.

model.name: Linear discriminant analysis
model.summary: Gaussian classes with a shared covariance; also projects onto the discriminant directions.

model.name: Multinomial naive Bayes
model.summary: Class-conditional multinomial counts with additive smoothing.

model.name: Quadratic discriminant analysis
model.summary: Gaussian classes, each with its own covariance.

model.name: Crammer–Singer multiclass SVM
model.summary: A single multiclass margin machine solved in the dual.

model.name: Linear SVM
model.summary: The soft-margin linear SVM by dual coordinate descent or Pegasos.

model.name: Support vector machine
model.summary: The soft-margin kernel SVM solved by SMO (kernel default: RBF with lengthscale 1).

model.name: Linear regression
model.summary: Least squares (ridge with an L2 penalty), with a Gaussian predictive.

model.name: Perceptron
model.summary: Rosenblatt's perceptron for two classes, trained by mistake-driven updates.

model.name: k-nearest neighbours
model.summary: Majority (or distance-weighted) vote of the k nearest training points.

model.name: k-nearest neighbours regression
model.summary: The (distance-weighted) mean target of the k nearest training points.

model.name: Max-abs scaler
model.summary: Divide each feature by its largest absolute value.

model.name: Min–max scaler
model.summary: Map each feature linearly onto a range, [0, 1] by default.

model.name: One-hot encoder
model.summary: One indicator column per category.

model.name: Ordinal encoder
model.summary: Each category to its integer index.

model.name: Polynomial features
model.summary: All monomials of the features up to a degree.

model.name: Power transform
model.summary: Box–Cox or Yeo–Johnson transform per feature with λ by maximum likelihood.

model.name: Random Fourier features
model.summary: Random cosine features whose inner products approximate an RBF kernel.

model.name: Robust scaler
model.summary: Centre each feature on its median and scale by its interquartile range.

model.name: Simple imputer
model.summary: Fill missing values per feature with its mean, median, mode or a constant.

model.name: Spline features
model.summary: A B-spline basis per feature.

model.name: Standard scaler
model.summary: Centre each feature and divide by its standard deviation.

model.name: Target encoder
model.summary: Each category to a shrunk mean of the target.

model.name: Whitening
model.summary: A linear map to identity covariance (PCA or ZCA whitening).

model.name: Nested dichotomies
model.summary: A binary tree of class splits whose branch probabilities multiply to class probabilities.

model.name: One versus one
model.summary: K(K−1)/2 pairwise binary problems combined by voting.

model.name: One versus rest
model.summary: K binary problems, each class against the rest; a predictive when the binary base has one. Capabilities declared for a logistic-regression base.

model.name: Error-correcting output codes
model.summary: One binary problem per column of a code matrix, decoded by Hamming or loss distance; the code is a required argument.

model.name: Random forest
model.summary: Bagged classification trees with random feature subsets at each split.

model.name: AdaBoost
model.summary: SAMME boosting of shallow trees (stumps by default).

model.name: Gradient boosting
model.summary: Stagewise fitting of regression trees to the negative gradient of a squared or logistic loss.

model.name: Decision tree
model.summary: CART classification tree grown greedily, with cost-complexity pruning.

model.name: Regression tree
model.summary: CART regression tree on squared error, with cost-complexity pruning.

model.name: Agglomerative clustering
model.summary: Repeated merging of the closest clusters under a linkage, cut into flat clusters.

model.name: DBSCAN
model.summary: Density-connected core points form clusters; the rest is noise.

model.name: Gaussian mixture
model.summary: A mixture of Gaussians fitted by EM; soft assignments are its predictive.

model.name: k-medoids
model.summary: Clusters represented by data points (medoids), by alternating assignment and medoid update.

model.name: k-means
model.summary: Lloyd's algorithm from k-means++ seeds, best of several restarts.

model.name: Mean shift
model.summary: Points climb a kernel density estimate to its modes, which are the clusters.

model.name: Mini-batch k-means
model.summary: k-means with centroid updates from random mini-batches.

model.name: OPTICS
model.summary: The reachability ordering of the points, from which DBSCAN clusterings at every ε can be read.

model.name: Spectral clustering
model.summary: k-means on the leading eigenvectors of a normalised graph Laplacian.

model.name: Kernel PCA
model.summary: PCA in the feature space of a kernel (RBF by default).

model.name: Metric multidimensional scaling
model.summary: An embedding whose distances match the data distances, by SMACOF stress majorisation.

model.name: Principal component analysis
model.summary: Projection onto the directions of largest variance.

model.name: Isomap
model.summary: Classical MDS of geodesic distances on a nearest-neighbour graph.

model.name: Laplacian eigenmaps
model.summary: The smallest non-trivial eigenvectors of a nearest-neighbour graph Laplacian.

model.name: Locally linear embedding
model.summary: An embedding that keeps each point’s reconstruction weights from its neighbours.

model.name: t-SNE
model.summary: Matching Gaussian neighbour probabilities with Student-t ones in the embedding, by gradient descent on their KL divergence.

model.name: UMAP
model.summary: A fuzzy nearest-neighbour graph laid out by stochastic gradient descent on a cross-entropy.

modifier.name: Shuffle
modifier.summary: Put the rows in a random order (generators group points by class).

modifier.name: Covariate shift
modifier.summary: Keep rows with a probability that rises along a direction in feature space.

modifier.name: Label noise
modifier.summary: Flip each label to another class at random with probability `rate`.

modifier.name: Label shift
modifier.summary: Resample within classes to new class shares, keeping p(x | y): a label shift.

modifier.name: Missing values
modifier.summary: Remove entries completely at random, at random given another feature, or not at random.

modifier.name: Nuisance features
modifier.summary: Append features drawn independently of everything else.

modifier.name: Outliers
modifier.summary: Replace a fraction of rows by draws from a broad Gaussian around the data mean.

modifier.name: Prevalence
modifier.summary: Resample within classes to a target share of class 1.

modifier.name: Linear map
modifier.summary: Rotate, shear and stretch the first two features (or apply any affine map); the truth maps along.

objective.name: Beale
objective.summary: A two-dimensional surface with sharp ridges and its minimum at (3, 0.5).

objective.name: Himmelblau
objective.summary: A two-dimensional surface with four global minima of value 0.

objective.name: Quadratic bowl
objective.summary: A convex quadratic with condition number κ, rotated in two dimensions.

objective.name: Rastrigin
objective.summary: A bowl covered in a regular grid of local minima; the global minimum is 0 at the origin.

objective.name: Rosenbrock
objective.summary: A curved, narrow valley with its minimum at (a, a², …): slow for gradient descent.

primitive.name: stopGradient
primitive.summary: x itself, treated as a constant by every derivative transform.

primitive.name: conv
primitive.summary: N-dimensional convolution (or cross-correlation) of [N, C, ...S] inputs with [O, C/groups, ...K] kernels.

primitive.name: convTranspose
primitive.summary: The transposed convolution: the adjoint of conv in its input.

primitive.name: convWeight
primitive.summary: The adjoint of conv in its kernel (the weight gradient).

primitive.name: linearFilter
primitive.summary: The output of the difference equation with feedforward coefficients b and feedback coefficients a.

primitive.name: pad
primitive.summary: Pad each axis by [lo, hi] samples read by a border mode.

primitive.name: padAdjoint
primitive.summary: The adjoint of pad: cotangents added back onto the positions they were read from.

primitive.name: fft
primitive.summary: The discrete Fourier transform along an axis (radix-2 or Bluestein).
primitive.formula: X_k = s \sum_{t=0}^{n-1} x_t e^{-2\pi i kt/n}

primitive.name: ifft
primitive.summary: The inverse discrete Fourier transform along an axis.
primitive.formula: x_t = s \sum_{k=0}^{n-1} X_k e^{2\pi i kt/n}

primitive.name: irfft
primitive.summary: The real signal of length n whose non-negative half-spectrum is the input (Hermitian extension).
primitive.formula: x_t = s \sum_{k=0}^{n-1} X_k e^{2\pi i kt/n}, \; X_{n-k} = \overline{X_k}

primitive.name: rfft
primitive.summary: The DFT of a real signal at its non-negative frequencies k = 0, …, ⌊n/2⌋.
primitive.formula: X_k = s \sum_{t=0}^{n-1} x_t e^{-2\pi i kt/n}, \; 0 \le k \le \lfloor n/2 \rfloor

primitive.name: abs
primitive.summary: The absolute value |x|.

primitive.name: add
primitive.summary: The sum a + b.

primitive.name: angle
primitive.summary: The argument (phase) arg z = atan2(y, x) in (−π, π].

primitive.name: argmax
primitive.summary: The index of the largest element.

primitive.name: argmin
primitive.summary: The index of the smallest element.

primitive.name: broadcastTo
primitive.summary: Broadcast to a shape by NumPy rules.

primitive.name: complex
primitive.summary: The complex number re + i·im.

primitive.name: complexAbs
primitive.summary: The modulus |z| = √(x² + y²) of a complex number.

primitive.name: concat
primitive.summary: Join tensors along an existing axis.

primitive.name: conj
primitive.summary: The complex conjugate x − iy.

primitive.name: cos
primitive.summary: The cosine (radians).

primitive.name: cumsum
primitive.summary: Running sums along an axis.

primitive.name: div
primitive.summary: The quotient a / b.

primitive.name: einsum
primitive.summary: Einstein summation over letter-labelled axes.

primitive.name: equalTo
primitive.summary: a = b, as 1 or 0.

primitive.name: euclideanNorm
primitive.summary: The Euclidean norm √Σx², scaled against overflow.

primitive.name: exp
primitive.summary: The exponential eˣ.

primitive.name: expj
primitive.summary: The unit phasor e^{iθ}.

primitive.name: expm1
primitive.summary: eˣ − 1, accurate for small x.

primitive.name: gather
primitive.summary: Read elements at flat indices.

primitive.name: greater
primitive.summary: a > b, as 1 or 0.

primitive.name: greaterEqual
primitive.summary: a ≥ b, as 1 or 0.

primitive.name: imagPart
primitive.summary: The imaginary part y of z = x + iy, as a zero-copy float64 view.

primitive.name: less
primitive.summary: a < b, as 1 or 0.

primitive.name: lessEqual
primitive.summary: a ≤ b, as 1 or 0.

primitive.name: linearCombination
primitive.summary: The linear combination Σ cᵢ xᵢ of same-shaped inputs with fixed coefficients.

primitive.name: log
primitive.summary: The natural logarithm.

primitive.name: log1p
primitive.summary: log(1 + x), accurate for small x.

primitive.name: logsumexp
primitive.summary: log Σ exp(x), without overflow.

primitive.name: matmul
primitive.summary: Batched matrix product with broadcast batch axes.

primitive.name: max
primitive.summary: The largest element.

primitive.name: maximum
primitive.summary: The larger of a and b.

primitive.name: min
primitive.summary: The smallest element.

primitive.name: minimum
primitive.summary: The smaller of a and b.

primitive.name: mul
primitive.summary: The product a·b.

primitive.name: neg
primitive.summary: Negation −x.

primitive.name: notEqualTo
primitive.summary: a ≠ b, as 1 or 0.

primitive.name: permute
primitive.summary: Reorder the axes.

primitive.name: pow
primitive.summary: The power aᵇ.

primitive.name: prod
primitive.summary: The product of the elements.

primitive.name: realPart
primitive.summary: The real part x of z = x + iy, as a zero-copy float64 view.

primitive.name: reshape
primitive.summary: The same elements with a new shape.

primitive.name: scatterAdd
primitive.summary: Add values into flat indices: the adjoint of gather.

primitive.name: scatterSlice
primitive.summary: Zeros with values written into a slice: the adjoint of slicing.

primitive.name: sign
primitive.summary: The sign of x: −1, 0 or 1.

primitive.name: sin
primitive.summary: The sine (radians).

primitive.name: slice
primitive.summary: Basic indexing: a view of part of a tensor.

primitive.name: sqrt
primitive.summary: The square root.

primitive.name: square
primitive.summary: The square x².

primitive.name: sub
primitive.summary: The difference a − b.

primitive.name: sum
primitive.summary: The sum of the elements.

primitive.name: sumTo
primitive.summary: Sum down to a shape: the adjoint of broadcasting.

primitive.name: tanh
primitive.summary: The hyperbolic tangent.

primitive.name: where
primitive.summary: Elementwise choice: a where the condition is non-zero, b elsewhere.

primitive.name: distanceFromSquared
primitive.summary: √u with derivative 0 at u = 0, for distances inside kernels.

primitive.name: relu
primitive.summary: The rectified linear unit max(0, x).

primitive.name: cholesky
primitive.summary: The Cholesky factor L of a symmetric positive-definite matrix, LLᵀ = A.

primitive.name: det
primitive.summary: The determinant of a square matrix.
